heading: Different records missed different decisions.
scope: We tested two ways to keep the same dated evidence for a simulated exchange. Both reached the same overall result, with different failures.

results.label: Storage tradeoff
results.measure: valid opportunities supported by the available evidence
results.summary: The chronological and relational views each missed a different storage-pressure case. Both lossless controls reached all five observable opportunities.

results.label: Late revocation
results.measure: after a revocation arrived too late
results.summary: Authority changed before the observer received the news. Both views proposed release; the simulated guard refused it. Better organization cannot recover evidence that had not arrived by the decision.
results.linkLabel: See the failure and its limits

limits: Twelve exposed synthetic cases; no real payments or model calls. Equal aggregate scores do not establish general capability. The guard knows stipulated world state; an actual distributed service would need to establish its own authority and timing guarantees.

next.question: Do these tradeoffs persist on new cases?
